about: Each place's recount rule for a state-level general election (owner, Nov 10, 2026: "Recount by own states rules"), read by the elections engine's count (src/core2/modules/voting.ts, keepCount). `automatic` and `request` are lists of tiers, the first whose `maxCast` (votes cast for the office) is at or over the race's applying: a margin qualifies when it is at or under `share` of the margin base (`marginOf`: all votes for the office, the top two's combined votes, or the winner's votes) and, with `join` lesser, also at or under `votes`; with `join` either, at or under one of them; a margin at or under `minVotes` always qualifies. A share of 0 is a tie only; a share of 1 is any margin. Null: none (no automatic recount, or a candidate may not ask). `days` is how long a recount takes from the count to its certified end. One rule a place: the statewide rule applies to every race there (stopgap SG-GOV-recount-one-rule-per-place).
sources: https://www.multistate.us/elections/recounts-101 (fetched Nov 11, 2026; its table follows each statute, linked by row)
